Which statement about the acceleration of the object when it is at point P is correct?
A
The acceleration is in the direction of arrow X.
B
The acceleration is in the direction of arrow Y.
C
The acceleration is in the direction of arrow Z.
D
The object is not accelerating.

options.label: A
options.text: The acceleration is in the direction of arrow X.

options.label: B
options.text: The acceleration is in the direction of arrow Y.

options.label: C
options.text: The acceleration is in the direction of arrow Z.
